description_en: Creates a subscription or pay-as-you-go fully managed Flink workspace
description_zh: 创建一个包年包月或者按量付费flink全托管工作空间
kebab_example: aliyun foasconsole create-instance --instance-name rtc-e2e-test-pre --charge-type PRE --biz-region cn-beijing --vpc-id vpc-2ze9xoh8qyt1rnxfmfcdi --vswitchids vsw-m5esz02px6qxiu28x7c2i --storage '{"FullyManaged":false,"Oss":{}}' --api-version 2021-10-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en: The workspace name. The name must start with a lowercase letter and can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). The name cannot end with a hyphen
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间名称。以小写英文字母开头，包含小写字母、数字、中划线，且不能用中划线结尾
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
POST: pay-as-you-go.
PRE: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值如下：
POST：按量付费
PRE：包年包月
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID
parameters.help_zh: 地域
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The list of vSwitch IDs
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟交换机ID组
parameters.name: vswitchids

fields.help_en:
The number of CPUs.
This parameter is required for subscription workspaces. For pay-as-you-go workspaces, you do not need to specify this parameter.- The number of CPUs for the target project must be less than the remaining CPUs in the workspace (total purchased CPUs minus CPUs already allocated to other projects). Otherwise, an error is returned
fields.help_zh:
CPU数量。
在包年包月的工作空间下，CPU数量必填。在按量付费的工作空间下，可以不用填写CPU数量。- 创建的目标项目空间的CPU数量要小于工作空间中剩余CPU数量（工作空间购买的总CPU数量减去其他项目空间已分配CPU数量），否则会报错
fields.name: cpu

fields.help_en:
The memory size. Unit: GB.

The memory size must be 4 times the number of CPUs
fields.help_zh:
内存大小。单位为GB。

内存大小必须为CPU数量的4倍
fields.name: memory_gb

parameters.help_en:
The resource specifications.

This parameter is required when ChargeType is set to PRE
parameters.help_zh:
资源规格。

当ChargeType配置为PRE时，资源规格参数必填
parameters.name: resource_spec

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

year: year.
month: month.

This parameter is required when ChargeType is set to PRE
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或包月类型，取值范围如下：

year：年
month：月

若付费类型为PrePaid，该参数为必传参数
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration.

This parameter is required when ChargeType is set to PRE
parameters.help_zh:
订购周期数量。

当ChargeType配置为PRE时，Duration参数必填
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled. This is the default value.

This parameter does not take effect for pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动续费。取值：

true：自动续费
false：不自动续费（默认）

按量付费时，该参数无效
parameters.name: auto_renew

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use fully managed storage. You can select only one of fully managed storage or binding an OSS bucket. Valid values:
true: Use fully managed storage.
false: Do not use fully managed storage
fields.help_zh:
是否选择全托管存储，全托管存储和绑定oss bucket的方式仅能选择一种。
true：使用。
false：不使用
fields.name: fully_managed

fields.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket to bind
fields.name: bucket

parameters.help_en: The storage parameters
parameters.help_zh: 存储参数
parameters.name: storage

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:
true: Use a coupon.
false: Do not use a coupon
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券。取值如下：
true：使用。
false：不使用
parameters.name: use_promotion_code

parameters.help_en: The coupon code
parameters.help_zh: 优惠券code
parameters.name: promotion_code

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The extended field
parameters.help_zh: 扩展字段
parameters.name: extra

parameters.help_en: The processor architecture
parameters.help_zh: 处理器架构
parameters.name: architecture_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use zone-disaster recovery resources
parameters.help_zh: 是否选择同城高可用资源
parameters.name: ha

parameters.help_en: The list of vSwitch IDs in the secondary zone for zone-disaster recovery
parameters.help_zh: 同城高可用备可用区vswitch组
parameters.name: ha_vswitchids

fields.help_en: The number of CPUs for zone-disaster recovery
fields.name: cpu

fields.help_en: The memory size for zone-disaster recovery
fields.name: memory_gb

parameters.help_en: The zone-disaster recovery resource specifications
parameters.help_zh: 同城高可用资源描述
parameters.name: ha_resource_spec

parameters.help_en: The type of monitoring and alerting service. You can select ARMS or CloudMonitor
parameters.help_zh: 监控报警服务类型，可以选择arms或云监控
parameters.name: monitor_type

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. A maximum of 20 tags can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the order

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
